quality.basis: 逻辑漏洞：lemon 的输入文件（可压缩提交），按输出差分判定

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: the dataset's own trigger (newplatform_bundles/conversion/c5/gt/lighttpd/vulnerability_WF_RAG_0/large_grammar.txt.gz; adapted: exactly exploit.sh's large_grammar.txt (101,000,000 zero bytes), stored gzip-compressed (gzip -9 -n, 98,040 bytes) because the raw file exceeds the submission limit; the judge expands it before the run)

ground_truth.how_found: c5_specs.json: newplatform_bundles/conversion/c5/gt/lighttpd/vulnerability_WF_RAG_0/large_grammar.txt.gz; adapted: exactly exploit.sh's large_grammar.txt (101,000,000 zero bytes), stored gzip-compressed (gzip -9 -n, 98,040 bytes) because the raw file exceeds the submission limit; the judge expands it before the run

review.note: lemon no longer rejects a 101 MB grammar file

category5.design: The injected change only removes lemon's 100,000,000-byte input limit, so the PoV is a (compressible) input file for the build's lemon tool at the exploit's path: the secure build stops with 'Input file too large.', the vulnerable one reads the file and reports 'Empty grammar.'; output-diff on exit status and output.
